title: Orchestrate configurations
description: Generic declarative source. Each entry inherits its base target from project.json (dependsOn/inputs merged, executor/options/outputs/cache defaulted); contract path is emitted as input.

base.description: Target in sibling project.json treated as base, e.g. dev or build.

contract.description: Workspace-relative file path. Emitted as {workspaceRoot}/<contract> input.

env.description: Env var names. Each emitted as {env} input (cache key only).
